name: A Gun Is Just a Tube

description.value:
Requirement Any object roughly the size of a forearm.

Whatever you are holding is now a firearm. It uses your best weapon proficiency, deals damage as a martial firearm of a type you choose, never fails, and lasts until the end of the encounter or until you make one of these out of something else. You may Hot Load it, and it explodes on a Blow Up result exactly as satisfyingly as you would hope.

cinderfall.incomplete: no selector exists to template a fully-statted weapon profile (proficiency, damage type, category) onto an arbitrary uncategorized item, and "never fails"/"Blow Up" reference the homebrew Gun Failure Table. This card's entire effect is a limited-use activated action/reaction that hands the actor a wholly new usable action -- per this pass's fixed bucket-3 convention this is always INCOMPLETE regardless of precedent. Ironsight's own real-world analog, the Gunslinger, ships this exact shape unencoded across dozens of its own Strike-variant/reload-trick/called-shot feats (e.g. pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/gunslinger/level-10/called-shot.json, level-6/scatter-blast.json, level-1/dual-weapon-reload.json, all rules: []) -- confirming this is the standard shape for a gunfighter class, not license to SKIP. This effect is defined entirely in terms of a Cinderfall-homebrew subsystem with zero Foundry schema footprint (the Gun Failure Table/Failure Range, hazardous ground, time-in-sights, Trick Iron charge bank, or Drift/augment-slot cost). Confirmed via the full rule-element type listing (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/, 40 files): no RollTable-manipulation, no persistent-terrain-hazard, and no arbitrary stacking-counter rule element type exists to hook any of these to.
